name: Stonetalon Pass (Mulgore)
summary: Stonetalon Pass is a rugged mountain trail tucked into the cliffs northwest of Thunder Bluff in Mulgore. Though the path terminates high on a secluded plateau, the pass is contested by the aggressive Grimtotem clan looking over the plains.

sections.title: A Treacherous Outpost
sections.body: Stonetalon Pass winds sharply up into the jagged mountain rim that divides Mulgore from the peaks of Stonetalon to the north. Instead of serving as an open highway for caravans, the trail climbs up to a windswept plateau capped by painted stones. Members of the Grimtotem tribe have established a presence on these high ledges, carving out a threatening vantage point right along the borders of the tauren heartland. Adventurers navigating the cliffs can look down upon the drop into Stonetalon Mountains, where the ravines of Boulderslide and the settlements of Malaka'jin lie far below.

faq.q: Does this pass lead directly into Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: The beaten trail technically dead-ends at a high painted rock on the plateau. However, intrepid mountaineers standing along the northern rim can carefully scale down the mountainside, dropping into Boulderslide Ravine or the lands near Malaka'jin.

faq.q: Why are the Grimtotem camped up here?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem have fortified several enclaves throughout Mulgore to challenge Cairne Bloodhoof and the united tauren tribes. This remote high ground gives them a secluded staging area overlooking northern Mulgore without being easily routed by Thunder Bluff's braves.

faq.q: What is unusual about the critters at the summit?
faq.answer: Travelers who linger at the summit plateau sometimes spot small local critters behaving strangely: prairie dogs donning acorn helms with daggers, rabbits clutching axes in their jaws, and mice brandishing miniature shotguns.

faq.q: Is Stonetalon Pass required to explore Mulgore?
faq.answer: Despite creating a noticeable blank spot on the northwestern rim of the Mulgore map, this high pass is not strictly required to earn credit for exploring the zone.

angles.text: The Grimtotem presence on these northern ridges poses an immediate threat to the peace Cairne Bloodhoof strives to maintain across the plains of Mulgore.
Clearing the Grimtotem encampments high on the northern bluffs helps protect the borders of Thunder Bluff from saboteurs and opportunistic raiders.
